description: Peak spike tier (§8.1): simulates short burst demand at 2x the practical estimate target (49,970 TPS) for 5 minutes. Mixed payload (70% one-to-one, 30% multi-output). Measures recovery behaviour and service stability after burst load.
walletProvisioningNote: external-key mode — set WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY to a pre-funded key whose UTxOs are initialized on the node before running replay scenarios
